interactive.description: Native Win32 Breakout: arrows or mouse, Space pauses, R restarts. Close both windows to exit.
interactive.name: breakout
interactive.provenance: Original MIT-licensed freestanding C demo; compiled to a Windows PE32 executable.

interactive.name: d3d12-blend
interactive.description: Native Direct3D 12 blending: three pipelines over one region with blend disabled, SRC_ALPHA/INV_SRC_ALPHA and additive ONE/ONE, so the final pixels prove each blend state reached the GPU. Close the window to exit.
interactive.provenance: Original MIT-licensed freestanding C demo; compiled to a Windows PE32 executable. Exercises D3D12 blend descriptors and multiple pipeline states.

interactive.name: d3d12-constants
interactive.description: Native Direct3D 12 root-constants cube: the per-frame transform reaches the vertex shader as 32-bit root constants, so nothing is re-uploaded. Close the window to exit.
interactive.provenance: Original MIT-licensed freestanding C demo; compiled to a Windows PE32 executable. Exercises D3D12 root constants and canonical descriptor bindings.

interactive.name: d3d12-constbuffer
interactive.description: Native Direct3D 12 cube driven by a constant buffer bound through a CBV descriptor table (the HelloConstBuffers shape). Close the window to exit.
interactive.provenance: Original MIT-licensed freestanding C demo; compiled to a Windows PE32 executable. Exercises D3D12 constant buffer views and descriptor tables.

interactive.name: d3d12-cube
interactive.description: Native Direct3D 12 rotating 3D cube: x87 transforms, indexed vertex uploads, browser-compiled shaders, D16 depth, command lists and fences. Close the window to exit.
interactive.provenance: Original MIT PE32 C application and HLSL shaders; native floating-point transforms during execution. Complete source and rebuild materials included.

interactive.description: Animated Direct3D 12 trefoil knot tube built with heap-placed resources and a three-buffer BGRA8 flip-discard swap chain.
interactive.name: d3d12-knot
interactive.provenance: MIT demo source built with i686-w64-mingw32; Wine 11 SM5 DXBC (LGPL-2.1-or-later).

interactive.name: d3d12-parade
interactive.description: Native Direct3D 12 'parade': 27 independently rotating, depth-tested, Gouraud-shaded cubes and octahedra drawn with indexed draws per frame; x87 guest transforms, browser-compiled shaders, D16 depth, command lists and fences. Close the window to exit.
interactive.provenance: Original MIT PE32 C application and HLSL shaders; native floating-point transforms and per-vertex lighting during execution. Complete source and rebuild materials included.

interactive.name: d3d12-rendertexture
interactive.description: Native Direct3D 12 render-to-texture: a gradient is drawn into an offscreen RTV texture, transitioned, then sampled through an SRV and composited. Close the window to exit.
interactive.provenance: Original MIT-licensed freestanding C demo; compiled to a Windows PE32 executable. Exercises D3D12 render-target textures and resource transitions.

interactive.name: d3d12-rootcbv
interactive.description: Native Direct3D 12 root constant buffer view: the per-frame transform is bound by GPU virtual address with SetGraphicsRootConstantBufferView, using no descriptor heap or table at all. Close the window to exit.
interactive.provenance: Original MIT-licensed freestanding C demo; compiled to a Windows PE32 executable. Exercises D3D12 root CBV descriptors.

interactive.name: d3d12-terrain
interactive.description: Native Direct3D 12 procedural terrain: a generated 129x129 height field drawn as 32,768 indexed triangles with 32-bit indices, a three-attribute vertex layout and a constant-buffer camera. Close the window to exit.
interactive.provenance: Original MIT-licensed freestanding C demo; compiled to a Windows PE32 executable. Generates its mesh in guest code and uploads it through the canonical D3D12 heap path.

interactive.name: d3d12-texture
interactive.description: Native Direct3D 12 textured cube: a generated 64x64 texture is uploaded through GetCopyableFootprints and CopyTextureRegion, then sampled from an SRV descriptor table with a static sampler. Close the window to exit.
interactive.provenance: Original MIT-licensed freestanding C demo; compiled to a Windows PE32 executable. Exercises D3D12 texture upload, SRV descriptor tables and static samplers.

interactive.name: d3d12-triangle
interactive.description: Native D3D12 shader triangle: browser-compiled SM5 shaders, moving viewport, command lists, resource transitions and fences. Initial API subset.
interactive.provenance: Original MIT PE32 API fixture embedding unmodified LGPL Wine shader bytecode; complete shader and application sources included.

interactive.name: d3d8-cube
interactive.description: Native Windows Direct3D 8 cube: browser x86-to-Wasm compilation, WebGPU transforms and depth. Close the window to exit.
interactive.provenance: Original MIT-licensed freestanding C graphics fixture; compiled to a Windows PE32 executable. D3D8 bootstrap subset, not WineD3D.

interactive.name: d3d9-cube
interactive.description: Native Windows Direct3D 9 cube: browser x86-to-Wasm compilation, WebGPU transforms and depth. Close the window to exit.
interactive.provenance: Original MIT-licensed freestanding C graphics fixture; compiled to a Windows PE32 executable. D3D9 bootstrap subset, not WineD3D.

interactive.name: d3d9-shader-cube
interactive.description: Native D3D9 programmable cube: x86-to-Wasm, x87 transforms, browser-compiled vertex/pixel shaders, float constants and depth. Close the window to exit.
interactive.provenance: Original MIT-licensed PE32 C application and shader tokens; complete source and rebuild materials included.

interactive.name: d3d10-cube
interactive.description: Native Direct3D 10 animated depth-tested cube: D3D10CreateDeviceAndSwapChain, an explicit input layout, per-stage register binding, render-target and depth-stencil views, and per-stage rasterizer/blend/depth state objects. Close the window to exit.
interactive.provenance: Original MIT-licensed freestanding C demo, built with i686-w64-mingw32; SM4.0 DXBC produced with Wine's d3dcompiler_47.

interactive.name: opengl-raymarch
interactive.description: Native OpenGL 3.3 / GLSL 330 3D raymarch demo with soft shadows and ambient occlusion. Arrows orbit; Space pauses; Escape exits.
interactive.provenance: MIT-licensed WineBrowser source-built PE32 fixture. Guest x86 and original GLSL compile in the browser.
